devdoc.title: Clank permanent liquidity locker
devdoc.details: The contract intentionally exposes no withdrawal, approval, transfer, or arbitrary-call surface. A recorded position therefore remains owned by this locker permanently.

params.positionManager_: Uniswap V4 PositionManager whose NFTs may be received.

collectFees(address).details: Zero liquidity is removed, so principal stays permanently locked while fees go directly to the factory's current protocol fee destination.

lockPosition(address,uint256,address).details: The NFT must already be owned by this locker. Explicit markers prevent reuse even when positionId is zero.
